dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (JMA standard receipt software); uses MCP (Medical Care Platform) copybooks and COMMON-SPA linkage pattern typical of ORCA/GnuCOBOL

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (receipt/shinryo-hoshu) system; specifically a subprogram to retrieve hospitalization management fee codes (nyuin iryokanri-ryo codes) for the JMA ORCA medical receipt software
purpose.summary: This subprogram retrieves and sets medical care management fee codes (iryokanri-ryo codes) for hospital admissions based on admission category (nyuin-kbn). It queries the system management master (tbl_syskanri) and sets appropriate procedure codes (srycd) into the return area based on admission type and various criteria such as acute/recovery/social rehabilitation periods.

notable_features: LINKAGE SECTION with USING clause (called subprogram)
Multiple COPY statements for ORCA MCP framework copybooks
EVALUATE/WHEN constructs for admission category branching
PERFORM VARYING loop over system management records
MCP-TABLE and MCP-PATHNAME pattern for database access
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS (uses MCP abstraction layer)
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually Japanese EUC-JP encoded, appearing as mojibake. This is consistent with the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system codebase. The program is a called subprogram (EXIT PROGRAM) with no file I/O of its own, relying entirely on MCP copybook-based database access routines.
